data.body:
LANDED as change 1066 (patchset 2), merged to main.

Patchset 1 hit a Merge Conflict after 2132 (change 1065) landed. The conflict was NOT in the workflow — it was in tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py, where both changes appended tests. The two sets were disjoint (2132's collection guard vs this change's loop guards) so both were kept. Note for the record: my first resolution was itself broken — git's ======= marker fell exactly where an assert's closing paren was, and 'git rebase --continue' committed the truncated statement. The completion verifier caught the resulting SyntaxError; amended before pushing ps2.

REAL pre-merge validation of the loop (the thing the Verified gate structurally cannot do for a workflow-file change, since workflow_dispatch resolves './' reusables from main): pushed the change as scratch/ad63-loop-validation to the GitHub mirror, which optionality.yml picks up on push. Run 30591336796 succeeded, and the log confirms the loop did the actual work rather than merely exiting 0:

  7 iterations, each exactly once, in 7 distinct venvs
  venv-agents venv-eval venv-grounding venv-mcp venv-metrics venv-tracing venv-union
  agents/eval/grounding/metrics/tracing -> 'installed + detected' (the _optional probe)
  mcp -> 'installed (no _optional probe)' + its rebar-mcp --help boot check ran
  union -> installed .[agents,eval,tracing] jointly

metrics installing + detecting is new coverage: it is in _optional.EXTRAS but had NO per-extra CI before this change. Scratch branch deleted after the run.

Also folded in: infra/github/main-protection.snapshot.json still named 'import-linter (no module-scope heavy imports)' after 1065 deleted that job. Not the live ruleset, but rollback-mirror-lock.sh POSTs it back, so an emergency rollback would have demanded a check that cannot exist. Removed, and the file's original single-line minified shape preserved (a first edit reformatted all 89 lines; reverted to a 1-line diff).

Deviation from the plan worth recording: the plan mandated the literal '|| { rc=1; ...; continue; }' accumulator. That trips shellcheck SC2015 through actionlint and fails make lint. Implemented as 'if ! { ...; }; then rc=1; ...; continue; fi' — same accumulator, same continue, same 'exit $rc', lint-clean.

Known stale prose left for a follow-up (comments only, no behavior): docs/llm-framework.md:49 and a comment in .github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml:134 still describe 'per-extra / union' jobs.
